question: Diff every compiled expression-graph body between 1.4.3.5 and 2.1.1.0 by its named listing and say which graphs changed in substance (the Stage 5 noise table calls the three re-bake fields non-gameplay).

control.description: A: three graphs whose source raw SHA-256 is equal on both builds and whose resource id did not change (SimEx_ForceWeaponChange_PLD; SimEx_ForceWeaponChange_m4a1; SimEx_GetProjectileOwnerPlayerInformation): listings identical apart from the header path (PASS). B: no graph has a byte-identical source and a changed id (0 of 115 re-baked; the resource id is stored in the source bytes, so a re-bake always changes the source). Surrogate: three re-baked graphs whose decoded sources differ only in the three re-bake fields (55 such; srcdiff.json): SetCaptureObjectivesTarget is identical apart from the id line; GetDamageContractValues and GetHeadshotContractValues each gain a 15th case in both game-mode SWITCHes (new value 14 maps to the default 0), raw-checked below. No byte-identical source gave a different listing, so the reader and pairing stand.

pairing.departure: The brief's 147 unchanged / 156 re-baked is the capture-batch split, not the id comparison: batch a (expression-graph-bodies-2026-10-30) holds 147 ids, all equal to 1.4.3.5 ids; batch b (-b-) holds 156 = 41 equal ids + 115 re-baked. Equal ids always have byte-equal bodies (188 of 188). 11 of the 319 routes are sources with no Class_25c12137 graph object on either build, so 304 graphs = 319 - 4 absent - 11 graphless.

variableTable.fact: Class_6b1a540c/77e7467b/a83e3e31/1614950b/6c4301da objects keyed by Field_dfd68748 (scope) and Field_91058a7f (index) name the reader's state variables; the 1.4.3.5 rebuild equals the copied mmp.json (985 keys); 2.1.1.0 has 1,009 keys and 743 moved names.

inference: Re-baked bodies are not noise: 17 of 115 re-baked graphs changed in substance and 16 gained a game-mode enum case; the source can stay equal apart from the three re-bake fields while the body changes.

65 re-baked graphs differ only by compiler lowering (AND/EQ with a true literal folded, OR lowered to short-circuit branches) and renumbered keys; this is a fingerprint match, not a line-by-line proof.
Contract graph changes belong to the new Spooky Rush mode; the ArmorGrant gate matches checklist U28; survival and outcome experience changes match the registry diff (Rapid Royale rows).
The enum-case additions map the new game-mode value 14 to each switch's default branch, so existing modes keep their values.
unresolved: Body ead5aa90ea53b389 (2.1.1.0 SimEx_BR_ApplyProgressionWeapon, re-baked from 06866f32948c98f7) is not in the current catalog: needs capture (or the source is stale); not diffed.

Six graphs fail exdis 'layout not found' on both builds (SimEx_ContractObjective, Default_InteractDisable, SimEx_Vehicle_Stationary, SimEx_UpdateRoundScores, two ContextAwareTutorialManager graphs); all six keep their id and their body bytes are equal, so they are identical by bytes but unlisted.

Four byte-identical bodies (SimEx_Soldier_ThermalSignature, SimEx_SPAIDisplacementLogic, SimEx_SPAIPatrolDisplacementLogic, SimEx_ForceRevivePlayer) name different variables under the 2.1.1.0 motion-machine table (e.g. GetFloat Soldier.ReviveTime -> ArchetypeSpeedModifier). Either the (scope, index) naming convention does not hold for these keys or these graphs were not re-baked after the table was renumbered; runtime binding is not established.

The 'compiler lowering and renumbering only' class is a fingerprint match (same calls, imports, named variables, aligned constants and switch sizes once boolean AND/OR/EQ/NOT wiring is set aside); the boolean wiring itself was checked by eye only on StepSmoothing, KillCam, SoldierMaster and WeaponFireSpotting, not on all 65.

Packed constants (multi-field words >= 0x10000, e.g. 0x0504xxxx moving by -1) are read as renumbered ids by inference; only keys that resolve to the same motion-machine variable on both tables are confirmed renumbering.
Native function hashes added or removed in the substantive graphs (e.g. 9988c791, 258aa274, bbd337f7, 1245ceba, 8b69382c) are unidentified; their behaviour is not stated.
The EA 2.1.1.0 patch-notes text is not held locally; patch-note explanations were judged through the checklist rows, which carry the patch-note items.
siteImpact: None for the site. No changed graph is a weapon attribute graph; ArmorGrant, IsInMandown, interaction and persistence rules are outside the site model. Research docs: SOLDIER.md L4023/L4028 rules for IsInMandown and SimEx_PlayerOwner keep their constants, but IsInMandown gained a PVE bleed-out branch; PROGRESSION.md L4027 rules for survival and outcome experience changed as the registry diff already noted.
